alarms.action: Set alarm M290, abort sequence to VENT, set FAIL result (M211), and energise ST20 fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25).
alarms.condition: Pack pressure PT-2001 fails to reach 14.50 kPa within 8.0 s (T21 done)
alarms.name: Fill timeout

alarms.action: Latch alarm M291, close fill valve, open vent valve, set FAIL result, and energise ST20 fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25).
alarms.condition: Pack pressure PT-2001 exceeds 20.00 kPa (D100 > D123)
alarms.name: Over-pressure

alarms.action: Set alarm M292, inhibit cycle start, hold unclamp in VENT, and energise ST20 fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25).
alarms.condition: PT-2001 reading drops below -5.00 kPa (D100 < K-500 indicating wire break)
alarms.name: PT-2001 signal fault

alarms.action: Latch alarm M293, abort sequence to VENT, set FAIL result, and energise ST20 fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25).
alarms.condition: PS-2009 supply air pressure switch lost (X22 OFF) while station is busy (M200 ON)
alarms.name: Supply air low

alarms.action: Abort sequence to VENT, set FAIL result, and energise ST20 fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25).
alarms.condition: E-stop chain healthy contact ES-0001 lost (X0 OFF) while station is busy
alarms.name: E-stop chain lost

interlocks.cause: Cell not in auto mode (X2 OFF), ST20 fault active (M299 ON), or station busy (M200 ON)
interlocks.effect: Inhibit test cycle start upon pallet arrival.

interlocks.cause: Pallet sensor (ZS-2008 / X23) transitions while test cycle is running
Clamp not confirmed closed (ZS-2002A / X20 OFF or ZS-2002B / X21 ON)
interlocks.effect: Inhibit opening of fill valve XV-2003 (Y21); close fill valve immediately if clamp signal is lost.

interlocks.cause: Pack pressure PT-2001 at or above 1.00 kPa or PT-2001 signal fault active (M292 ON)
interlocks.effect: Inhibit clamp release and hold station in VENT step with vent valve XV-2004 (Y22) open.

interlocks.cause: Active fault (M299 ON) or E-stop chain lost (X0 OFF) while station is busy (M200 ON)
interlocks.effect: Abort sequence to VENT step (M205) and latch FAIL result (M211).

interlocks.cause: Overpressure condition detected (PT-2001 / D100 > 20.00 kPa / D123)
interlocks.effect: De-energise fill valve XV-2003, hold vent valve XV-2004 open, latch overpressure alarm (M291), and set FAIL result.

interlocks.cause: Manual vent pushbutton PB-2010 (X25) pressed while cell is in manual mode (X2 OFF)
Station not in DONE step (M207 OFF)
interlocks.effect: Inhibit transmission of PASS (RS-2006 / Y23) and FAIL (RS-2007 / Y24) signals to line controller.

steps.entry: Pallet arrives at test position (ZS-2008 / X23 rising edge) with cell in auto mode (SS-0003 / X2), no active ST20 fault (M299 OFF), and station idle (M200 OFF).
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed closed (ZS-2002A / X20 ON) and clamp open sensor clear (ZS-2002B / X21 OFF).
steps.name: Clamp

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed closed (M201 exit condition satisfied).
steps.exit: Pack pressure PT-2001 reaches fill threshold (14.50 kPa / D100 >= D122) or fill timeout timer (T21 / 8.0 s) elapses.
steps.name: Fill

steps.entry: Pack pressure reaches fill threshold (14.50 kPa).
steps.exit: Stabilisation timer (T22) elapses (3 s per narrative / 5.0 s per parameter sheet).
steps.name: Stabilise

steps.entry: Test window timer (T23) elapses, or station aborts due to an active fault (M299) while busy.
steps.exit: Vent timer elapses, pack pressure PT-2001 drops below 1.00 kPa, and PT-2001 signal is healthy (M292 OFF).
steps.name: Vent

steps.entry: Vent time elapsed, pack pressure < 1.00 kPa, and PT-2001 signal healthy.
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed open (ZS-2002B / X21 ON) and clamp closed sensor clear (ZS-2002A / X20 OFF).
steps.name: Unclamp

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed open (M206 exit condition satisfied).
steps.exit: Pallet departs test position (ZS-2008 / X23 OFF).
steps.name: Done
